$comment: Machine-readable AdPilot color palette. Ported from an earlier project's validated palette; hex values are unchanged, names below are renamed to AdPilot's own domain (brief item status, anomaly severity, audit trail) instead of the source app's.
rule: Hold chroma constant across a tier; solve OKLCH lightness per hue to hit one target WCAG relative luminance.

brand.note: clay rose — locked AdPilot brand colour, never a status

critical.note: anomaly severity=CRITICAL; refused-answer and error states

rejected.#c17137: ~10 degrees from Anthropic's Claude accent and the worst white-on-fill contrast of six candidates (3.69:1). Do not reintroduce.
rejected.#d97757: Anthropic's Claude accent itself. Avoid this hue band entirely.

constraints.colorIsNeverSoleMeaning: The status colours collapse under deuteranopia (forecast/audited delta-E 0.016). Always pair with a text label, shape or direct annotation.
constraints.bordersAreNotBoundaries: Neutral borders measure 1.21:1 and 1.52:1 — fine as separators, never as the sole boundary of a control.
